statements.t: "We are excited about the growth opportunities ahead in fiscal 2027, with revenue expected to be in the range of $195 million to $205 million, supported by an anticipated gradual recovery in broadband demand and the expected ramp-up of our data center business.”
Outlook For fiscal 2027, we expect net sales to be in the range of $195 million to $205 million, and net income per share to a range of $0.25 to $0.46.

For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, we expect net sales in the range of $48 million to $52 million, operating expenses as a percentage of net sales to remain consistent with the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, and net income (loss) per share in the range of $(0.06) to $0.03.

Our guidance also reflects our current expectations regarding the current data center environment and potential supply chain constraints of optical fiber, cable and connectors mentioned in our previous letters to shareholders, as well as our current understanding of the impact of the evolving tariff situation, both which could contribute to uncertainty in our business and in the macroeconomic environment.
